# About Me

Hi! I’m **Jonathan Lieb**, and I'm a PhD statistics student at Baylor University.
I enjoy applying simple linear models, time series methods, and machine learning techniques to build models and tackle problems, especially in the world of sports.

## Interests

- Sports Analytics  
- Predictive Modeling  
- Time Series  
- Bayesian Modeling
